meta.head: ed9926db
meta.note: Proposed ADDITIONS only; examples/index.json was not edited. Live projects must also have sonic.live (test-enforced); none of these is live. Categories avoid the live-only categories Astral Forge, Digital Mosh, Sonic Abstract, Sonic Garden, Sonic VFX, The Rift.

additions.name: Astral Forge - Trench
additions.description: The Astral Forge rendered on Trench: a god of metal dust assembles from the music, holds a face and collapses on the drop.
additions.note: Category must not be "Astral Forge" (a live category; tests/unit/test_example_menu.cpp forbids a live category under Examples). Needs assets/audio/trench.wav (owner-supplied).

additions.name: Digital Mosh - Feline Footwear
additions.description: Datamosh flythrough rendered on Feline Footwear.

additions.name: Chorus Field - Trench God
additions.description: A curtain of ~5k fibers becomes a demonic silver skull through eddy fields; bass forms the god, breakdowns dissolve it.

generate.produces: chorus-field/p*.json + .scene.json (tracked; only needed after editing build.py)

additions.name: Liminal - All You Got
additions.description: The All You Got music video: one continuous walk through pale, impossible liminal rooms (pass 4 final).
additions.note: Audio path is ~/Desktop/All You Got.wav (owner machine only); loads without it with a missing-asset warning (TBD coordinator).

additions.name: Biovalley - Macro
additions.description: Static-camera, audio-reactive bioluminescent forest floor built from the Blender hero-asset library, on Trench.

generate.produces: examples/biovalley/meshes/, sky/, shots/macro.json, shots/macro_audio.json (gitignored); requires the Blender-built meshes/hero and meshes/env (examples/biovalley/hero_assets/build.py + colorways.py) and a built engine

additions.note: Adding it makes tests/integration/test_project_system.cpp:705 fail on any checkout that has not run valley.py (it REQUIREs the file to exist): needs a generate-or-skip guard like test_rift first.

additions.name: The Tide
additions.description: An enormous translucent body moving through a warm luminous medium (early ocean prototype).

additions.name: Glowmere Valley 2 - Song
additions.description: Glowmere Valley 2 cut to the song structure (auto-director over song sections).
additions.note: Owner rule: Glowmere is protected; audio ~/Desktop/Rebuild.mp3 (owner machine only).

additions.name: Procedural Space - Showcase
additions.description: The Procedural Space POC showcase preset.
additions.note: Six more presets exist (folding-space, geometry-explosion, infinite-hall, radial-architecture, recursive-cathedral, experiment-melt-void); index only if wanted.

additions.name: Bioluminescent Valley (recipe)
additions.description: A cinematic alien rainforest at night composed from a recipe.
additions.note: A recipe entry uses the key "recipe" rather than "project" in index.json.

additions.name: Open Vista (stress)
additions.description: Renderer stress profile: 1.4 km of mountainous relief, thin ground cover, large negative space.

additions.name: Sonic Garden - variants
additions.description: (optional) The Sonic Garden phrase through each timbre: pad, bell, bass, perc, morph, context.
